scene: Her portrait prints onto blush paper as a polaroid, pink layer first, then teal, then ink; on the second "smile" a gold glint lands on it.
Stein sits on the edge of his bed at night holding the polaroid; a doodled heart floats up out of it.
A stack of paper grows under Stein's feet and lifts him past a ruler drawn up the wall; the camera rises with him.
Instrumental break: "mbastein" prints in gold foil with a pink off-register shadow; "give me life" types in below; the Ring rolls across.
Stein drops the polaroid into a drawer and shuts it; on the second "anymore" the drawer creeps back open.
Close on a phone calling "Precious": ring arcs go out in ink and turn to grey smoke; the screen reads "no answer", then "call failed".
Moving boxes slide out of her empty room, leaving a pale rectangle on the wall where her picture hung.
Precious dances under a paper disco ball; pink and mint light spots swirl and a record spins.
A folded map of California opens; a dotted line runs south to a gold pin; pop-up palm trees spring up by a mint ocean.
Inside a phone Stein is holding: Precious under a palm at sunset beside Smoke, the other man, drifting in sunglasses.
A banana peel slides under Stein's sneaker and he steps over it without looking; behind him a row of plain grey guys, he is the only one in colour.
Stein jogs with Biscuit; Biscuit stops at a hydrant and lifts a leg (a tiny dotted arc); Stein laughs.
A teal lowrider hops on the beat; its hood pops open on an empty engine bay with a doodled note: no pistons.
Stein in profile; a cut-away of his head shows gears turning until a gold bulb switches on.
Precious walks arm in arm with Smoke; Stein peeks round a corner with one eyebrow up under a doodled question mark.
Two puzzle pieces, Precious and Smoke, click together; a third piece, Stein, drops out and his hand picks it up.
A photo album opens and off-register snapshots flip past: ice cream, a rooftop, a car at night.
Precious runs across pop-up rooftops carrying a small glowing globe of her own.
Stein and Precious stand on opposite sides of a folded page; a pink thread links their hearts and pulses.
The thread tightens; Precious reaches toward the Ring floating between them and her fingertip almost touches it.
Speech bubbles on little legs crawl around Stein in circles, scribbled full of bla bla.
Smoke's speech bubble shows a ringing phone; Stein's phone reads 0 missed calls; a paper-plane message loops past him and dissolves.
Every layer snaps into register and a gold seam tears the page open top to bottom.
Precious glows in gold rays; Stein holds out empty hands with only paper scraps in them.
A paper-doll chain of her friends unfolds across the frame; one doll inks itself into Stein and the others turn to look.
Stein and Precious ride a mine cart through gold-veined rock by lantern light, talking in gold-nugget speech bubbles.
A balance scale: Precious in gold on one pan outweighs a heap of cars, chains and cash on the other.
The cover comes alive: the gold Ring turns on pink and mint washes with grey smoke; PRECIOUS stamp.
Stein sits on a paper throne in a crown while gold rings orbit him like planets; PRECIOUS stamp.
Stein hunches over the Ring clutched to his chest, eyes wide, pulled along by it; PRECIOUS stamp.
Precious struts in slow motion, full figure, gold rays behind her; pink paper flowers pop open as she passes; PRECIOUS stamp.
Paper hands clap in from every edge around Precious in a spotlight; PRECIOUS stamp.
The Ring spins on its edge like a coin on paper, wobbles and settles; PRECIOUS stamp.
Precious blows on a dandelion and its seeds become gold sparks; PRECIOUS stamp.
Scissors cut a heart out of the page along a dotted line; the Ring drops into the hole and fills it with gold; PRECIOUS stamp.
A sheet folds itself into an origami diamond that turns to gold; PRECIOUS stamp.
Precious winks; pink blush circles print on her cheeks and tiny hearts pop; PRECIOUS stamp.
Precious dances on the beat and a gold crown drops onto her curls; PRECIOUS stamp.
A ring box snaps open, empty; a doodled "(yet)" appears beside it; PRECIOUS stamp.
Now Precious sits on the throne with the rings orbiting her while Stein kneels; PRECIOUS stamp.
A giant pointing hand presses down toward a small Precious; the Gauge drops into the corner and its needle starts to climb.
Stein steps in front of her and pushes back against the giant hand.
Stein holds a hydraulic press up over his head as it squashes down; PRESSURE stamp.
Stein rolls past on a stretcher, bandaged and grinning with a thumbs-up, Biscuit riding on his chest.
Night paper: the stretcher rolls under a moon and streetlights with Precious walking beside it.
A lump of coal goes under the press, the press comes down and Precious smiles; PRESSURE stamp.
A slow dance in a pink spotlight, his hand at her waist; PRESSURE stamp.
A heart-shaped bellows pumps a paper heart until it swells tight; PRESSURE stamp.
The Ring sits on a velvet stand behind a rope and a do-not-touch card; Precious's fingertip reaches in and sparks; PRESSURE stamp.
Precious in heart sunglasses with a Ring Pop candy; PRESSURE stamp.
Precious rubs a gold lamp; grey smoke pours out and curls into a heart; PRESSURE stamp.
A riso press prints paper money that flies out and stacks up; PRESSURE stamp.
Stein carries the Ring into a little paper hut and its window glows gold; PRESSURE stamp.
Stein at a desk as money stacks grow and the clock hands spin; the Gauge nears the top; PRESSURE stamp.
Precious runs circles around Stein and he spins to keep up; PRESSURE stamp.
Her speech bubble says "a man around"; Smoke drifts into the doorway and dissolves; Stein steps in, solid; PRESSURE stamp.
In a paper octagon Precious, in pink gloves, hip-throws Stein; he flies in slow motion and the Gauge bursts into confetti; PRESSURE stamp.
Confetti settles; Stein lies on the mat grinning and Precious offers her hand.
Stein on one knee opens the ring box; the Ring is inside.
The Ring passes into Precious's hand, the smoke clears, and the page folds shut on the gold mbastein end card.
